name: app-secrets-and-env
description: Store credentials (API tokens, passwords) securely on Astrolift and wire configuration into workloads — secrets injected as env vars, plain config in the manifest. Use whenever an app needs to talk to an external service or hold any key.

name: astro-cli
description: Install and use the astro CLI — authenticate via browser device flow, check platform status, validate manifests, drive CI deploys, and diagnose permissions from the terminal.

name: astrolift-deploy
description: Check, debug, or explain an Astrolift app's deploy — CI run status, what each step failure means, rollout state, logs, and rollback. Use after merging, or whenever "the deploy failed" or the live site looks stale.

name: astrolift-platform
description: The capability map of the Astrolift platform an app runs on — workload kinds, delivery, scheduling, secrets, managed services, observability, agents/workflows, tokens, and RBAC. Read before designing anything that touches deployment, infrastructure, scheduling, or integrations, so you build WITH the platform instead of around it.

name: csv-process
description: Read, filter, select, aggregate, and join CSV / tabular data without spinning up a full data stack.

name: data-transform
description: jq-style select, filter, and reshape over JSON and YAML — extract paths, map arrays, and filter records without writing throwaway code.

name: export
description: Write a dataset (array of records) to CSV, JSON, XLSX, or PDF through one interface — format chosen by the output extension.

name: file-ops
description: Read, write, search, and edit files in the workspace safely — atomic writes, exact-match edits, and recursive content search.

name: git
description: Everyday git — clone, branch, stage, diff, commit, and push, with a safe, predictable workflow.

name: http-request
description: Make HTTP/REST requests with auth, custom headers, query/body, pagination, retries with backoff, and structured error handling.

name: mcp-client
description: Connect to a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, perform the handshake, discover its tools, and invoke them over JSON-RPC.

name: pdf-generate
description: "Print to PDF" — render a markdown/text report (headings, paragraphs, bullet lists) to a clean PDF document.

name: schedule-tasks
description: Schedule recurring or one-off work on Astrolift — "run this every X hours" or "at a certain time" — by declaring a cronjob workload in astrolift.toml. Use instead of CI cron or any external scheduler.

name: shell
description: Run shell commands safely — correct quoting, exit-code handling, output capture, and timeouts.
